<a id="def-001"></a>
### DEF-001 · The generated types named a type twice and lost the links' pair of keys

`2026-11-04` · tool · minor · ✓ fixed · tags: `format`

- **Finding:** The first component/document.ts generated from the schema had Name1, Description1 and Status1 beside Name, Description and Status, and typed the links as [unknown, unknown][].
- **Cause:** json-schema-to-typescript turns every titled field (pydantic titles each one) and every reference beside a default into a type of its own, and does not read prefixItems, the 2020-12 form of a tuple.
- **Solution:** The schema is generated without field titles; a reference beside a default is written anyOf[reference]; the pair of keys carries its TypeScript type (tsType, a keyword validators ignore).
- **Result:** One type per class and per vocabulary; the links typed [string, string][].
- **Lesson:** A generated file is read once by a person before it is trusted: up to date is not the same as right.
- **Proof:** `tests/format/test_generated_types.py`
- **Links:** FORMAT-02

<a id="def-002"></a>
### DEF-002 · The zones' names were never drawn above their columns

`2026-11-04` · code · minor · ✓ fixed · tags: `component`

- **Finding:** On the demo page, the map showed its columns without their names (As received, Checked…), though the layout kept room for them; Portfolio Advisor's map, the one extracted, has the same gap.
- **Cause:** When the map moved to Svelte Flow, its hand-drawn zone titles were not carried over: only the tables became nodes, and no test looked for the titles.
- **Solution:** Each zone's name is a node of its own above its column, never picked, so it zooms and pans with the map.
- **Result:** Every column is named; Portfolio Advisor gets them when it moves to data-map.
- **Lesson:** When a drawing moves to a library, list what the old one showed, and test each item.
- **Proof:** `tests/component/map.test.ts`
- **Links:** MAP-01
